verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair question for a developer platform that ships AI features like Copilot, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a setting or policy that excludes user code or data from model training. The Copilot settings page (github-docs-53) mentions configurable settings but nothing about training. The community note that Copilot was trained on public GitHub code (github-comm-12) describes past training, not a user control.
